name: shift-left-guard
description: DevSecOps guardrails for Claude: scans every workflow, Dockerfile, Terraform, Kubernetes, Compose, package.json, agent config and secret Claude writes, makes it fix the issues itself, scores your repo, and asks before destructive cloud commands.

blockAt.title: Block at severity
blockAt.description: Findings at or above this severity stop the write so Claude fixes them first; lower ones are passed to Claude as a note after the write.

cloudGuard.title: Destructive cloud commands
cloudGuard.description: ask: put terraform destroy, gcloud/aws/az deletes, kubectl delete ns and the like to you first. deny: Claude never runs them. off: no check.

explain.title: Learning mode
explain.description: Explain every finding: why it is dangerous, its CWE, and Claude explains it to you in its reply. Made for learners and teams new to DevSecOps.
